tools.name: canopy_check_bookable
tools.description: Given businesses you already found for the user (name plus phone, website or address), report which ones can be booked through Canopy and how (booking_mode). Results come back in exactly the order you sent them. Canopy never ranks, filters or recommends businesses. Results are returned in the same o

tools.name: resolve_business
tools.description: Match one business the user named to its Canopy listing, by phone, website, or name (add the city, state or ZIP code when you know it). Returns at most one match, with its booking_mode and locations, or found=false. When a name alone is not certain, found=false comes with up to 5 candidates in alpha

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: List open appointment slots for a Canopy business, optionally for one service and one location, between two dates. Slots are cached from the business calendar (see synced_at); the time is re-checked live when you book.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Start a booking with a Canopy-connected business. Canopy automatically routes to the correct flow based on the operator's booking mode: auto-confirm (booked right away in the business's calendar; the customer is emailed a confirmation), request-times (propose preferred times), or submission-only (ca

tools.name: propose_times
tools.description: Propose preferred times to a business that reviews booking requests. The business will approve one time (that books it; the customer is emailed a confirmation) or propose an alternative (the customer confirms it from an emailed code). Check status with get_request_status.

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Request a callback from a business. They will contact the customer directly. No calendar booking is created.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Check the status of a booking request (preferred times or callback). Returns pending, approved, rejected, counter_proposed, expired, or converted. Needs the manage_token that came back when the request was made.

tools.name: reschedule_booking
tools.description: Ask to move a booking the customer already confirmed (booked with the business) to another open slot of the same service and location (slot_id from get_availability). tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking made through Canopy. The appointment is called off in the business's calendar right away and the customer is emailed. tools.name: get_business_terms
tools.description: Get the prices of a Canopy business's bookable services, its fees and its cancellation terms, exactly as the business has them on file. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_booking" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
